decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	Before the development, permitted under planning permission reference 00727/38/P1, is first occupied the landscaping approved under this permission (for the avoidance of doubt 00727/38/P1  (2A) shall have been carried out in all respects in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 2 - 
2.	If within a period of three years from the date of the planting of any tree, that tree, or any tree planted in replacement for it, is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, (or becomes, in the opinion of the Local Planning Authority, seriously damaged or defective) then another tree of the same species and size as that originally planted shall be planted at the same place, unless the Local Planning Authority gives its written consent to any variation.
description: Following approval for demolition of existing bungalow and erection of 2 No. semi-detached houses including one detached garage and one attached garage (OUTLINE PLANNING APPLICATION FOR SITING AND ACCESS ONLY)- details submitted pursuant to Condition 2 (Landscaping) of approved planning 00727/38/P1 dated 26/10/2006
